drivingQuestion: What principle underlies the dispute over purchasing a path?
outcomeNote: Unit breaks mid-sentence; the suggestion is completed and tested in the following sugya.

segments.he: וְצָרִיךְ לִיקַּח לוֹ דֶּרֶךְ, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא. וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: אֵינוֹ צָרִיךְ וְכוּ׳. מַאי, לָאו בְּהָא קָא מִפַּלְגִי –
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «And» the seller «must purchase for himself a path» through the buyer’s domain; this is «the statement of Rabbi Akiva. And the Rabbis say:» The seller «need not» purchase such a path. «What, is it not about this» issue, which will immediately be explained, that Rabbi Akiva and the Rabbis «disagree?»
